description: Listing of General Waste Collectors is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by National Environment Agency. This dataset provides a up-to-date list of all National Environment Agency (NEA)-licensed General Waste Collectors operating in Singapore. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher National Environment Agency. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-01-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
